summary.headline: Planetary Directions and Years
summary.text: Astrological rules for assigning mean years, minor years, months, or days according to a nativity ruler’s house position, retrogradation, combustion, angularity, and aspects. Fortunes increase the allotted years by degrees, malefics diminish them, and the Dragon’s head or tail within eight degrees is said to reduce them by a quarter.
